concepts.title: 1. Corrupted Foundry
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single wide 16:9 cinematic 3D environment concept image for the DRMVYZ Glitch Array music visualizer, direction CORRUPTED FOUNDRY. Full-frame environment only, no app UI, no text, no collage. The preset DNA is dark graphite beveled cubes in staggered grids, cold cyan inset light strips and sparse amber checkpoint lights. Show an enormous intricate enclosed industrial foundry with dark structural walls, overhead machinery, articulated support arms, precision rails, inspection gantries, service decks, deep rear alcoves and hundreds of substantial beveled cube cells arranged in suspended architectural banks. Camera is inside the world at a slightly elevated oblique viewpoint with a large close foreground bank, an engaging central assembly and deep background machinery. A visible geometric glitch ripples through a central cube grid: several rows shear sideways in precise stepped offsets, selected cells lift and rotate slightly, narrow slices misalign while neighboring cells remain orderly. It should feel physically dimensional and rhythmically choreographed. Wet-looking dark metal reflections restrained, brushed metal, machined seams, bolts, bevel highlights and occlusion, selective cyan light revealing surfaces, tiny warm amber markers, subtle atmospheric depth. Rich readable shadows, beautifully controlled highlights and reflections, premium detailed real-time 3D rendering. Keep the whole structure readable; no blown-out bloom, no people, no neon rainbow, no generic central glowing orb, no flat digital glitch overlay.

concepts.title: 2. Broken Memory City
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single wide 16:9 cinematic 3D environment concept image for the DRMVYZ Glitch Array music visualizer, direction BROKEN MEMORY CITY. Full-frame environment only, no app UI, no text, no collage. Visual DNA: substantial dark graphite beveled cubes, staggered precise grids, thin cyan emission strips and occasional amber checkpoints. Depict an immense intricate deserted city assembled from cubic memory architecture: tall stepped towers made of beveled cube cells, suspended fragmented building banks, stacked terraces, connecting bridges, recessed service corridors, elevated road-like data conduits, geometric rooftop machinery and a deep central urban canyon. View from within the canyon on a foreground terrace, looking between close sculptural towers toward distant layered architecture. Make the city physically detailed rather than a field of abstract floating cubes. Show an intentional spatial glitch traveling across several towers: one horizontal band has shifted several meters sideways leaving clean stepped gaps, partial building segments temporarily suspend above their correct grid positions, orderly buildings elsewhere provide contrast. Cyan address lights trace selected routes through the city; sparse amber lights punctuate checkpoints. Deep blue-black atmosphere, dark metallic and graphite concrete surfaces, finely beveled edges, small engraved panels, real contact shadows, selective reflections, subtle fog diminishing distant districts. Architectural scale, strong parallax and multiple occluding depth layers, atmospheric premium real-time 3D render, readable shadow detail and restrained bloom. No people, no cars, no readable signage, no colorful cyberpunk advertising, no giant central orb, no flat RGB corruption filter.

Full-frame environment only, no app UI, no text, no collage. Visual DNA: substantial dark graphite beveled cubes and staggered grids, narrow cyan light strips, sparse amber checkpoint lights. Imagine an immense subterranean archaeological excavation revealing a buried computational megastructure. Rough dark basalt cavern walls and overhead rock strata surround ancient precise cubic machinery emerging from the ground and climbing the cavern walls. Layered excavation terraces, narrow metallic catwalks, anchored survey devices, detailed exposed structural ribs, cable channels, partially unearthed cube banks and deep shafts create a complete intricate environment. Camera looks obliquely down from a close foreground catwalk across the excavation into deeper caverns. Cyan signals travel along cracks between engineered cells; tiny amber survey lamps illuminate selected machinery. Clearly distinguish rough matte stone from smooth machined graphite cubes and metallic support hardware. Dark haunting atmosphere, finely detailed textures, realistic grazing highlights, contact shadows, patches of cyan reflected light on stone, subtle dusty volumetric light shafts and deep distance haze, premium cinematic real-time 3D concept render. Readable geometry in darkness with controlled bloom, no lava, no neon rainbow, no fantasy crystals, no people, no central glowing orb, no flat screen glitch overlay.
